question: Where’s the closest fast food restaurant along the travel direction toward Engelheim Vineyards Tasting Room, Ellijay, GA?
sql: WITH destination_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Engelheim Vineyards Tasting Room%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Ellijay%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%GA%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, destination_poi AS d WHERE d.geometry IS NOT NULL AND p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, d.geometry::geography, 50000) -- Search within a 50km radius for efficiency ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, d.geometry::geography) LIMIT 1;
